offences.quote: Failure to reference the use of Gen AI, including the submission of work which is not a student’s own, will in all cases be considered a matter of Academic Misconduct.

detection.quote: AUB recognises that there is no fool-proof detection software for Gen AI.
There are certain indicators that work was not generated by the student, and these are likely to be evident to a human assessor without the use of detection software.

definitions.quote: Generative AI (Gen AI) is a tool or ‘instrument’ which uses algorithms to generate content.
